description: The initiative will combine industry-linked certification, startup incubation and AI research through an integrated platform with real-world testbeds.
body_lead: The Karnataka government has approved a ₹35 crore Karnataka Artificial Intelligence Hub at the International Institute of Information Technology-Bangalore (IIIT-B), bringing together AI skilling, startup support and research as the state works towards setting up a proposed AI university. The state Cabinet approved the AI Hub on September 9. Electronics, IT/BT and Home Minister Priyank Kharge said the Hub would serve as part of the foundation for the university.
